_comment: Eclipse Mosquitto (MQTT broker) overlay. Apply with --profile mosquitto. Arrays APPEND to the base config; EDIT the bind 'source' paths (they must exist). See profiles/README.md.
_comment_net: Mosquitto listens on 1883 (+ 8883/9001 if configured). uxcd does no port mapping - run it on the host network, or in a shared 'infra' netns with the clients that need it.
_comment_config: Provide a mosquitto.conf in the config dir (set 'persistence true' + 'persistence_location /mosquitto/data/' to keep retained messages).
